title: Seattle · Mount Rainier Sunrise Loop
slogan: A 292 km loop out of Enumclaw fuel
story: Volcano views with serious seasonal checks. 283 km round from Enumclaw - plan on about 5 h 26 of riding. The stops in between: Packwood and Mount Rainier. Sunrise Road is the high point. It tops out at about 1,550 m. It is a high-mountain day. The plan has 1 food stop and 1 fuel stop marked.

sections.advice: Use Seattle start → Enumclaw fuel as clean positioning. Keep it tidy, ignore impatient traffic and save the enthusiasm for the good road ahead. The value here is not drama; it is arriving at the riding section with space, fuel and concentration intact.

This Sunrise Road → Packwood food stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

Packwood food → Mount Rainier viewpoint is the logistics leg. Watch junctions, villages and speed changes, then let the roadbook do its job: move you out of the clutter without spending your best attention too early.
